gap_statement: No certified (provable) poisoning defence has been evaluated for in-context tabular foundation models, even though ICL makes partition-aggregation cheap (k forward passes instead of k trainings)
closest_prior_work: Levine & Feizi DPA (ICLR 2021); Jia et al. bagging cert (AAAI 2021); Wang et al. Finite Aggregation (ICML 2022); TabPATE (arXiv 2606.31474)

importance: High: TFMs entering security/finance/health where training rows are untrusted
testability: High: certificates are deterministic and computable

gap_statement: The Lethal Dose Conjecture's prediction that more data-efficient base learners yield proportionally stronger certificates (Θ(N/n)) has not been tested on a model class with extreme small-sample efficiency
closest_prior_work: Wang, Levine, Feizi LDC (NeurIPS 2022); Wang & Feizi practical aspects (arXiv 2306.16415)
why_gap_remains: Tested only with augmentation-improved CNNs on CIFAR-10/GTSRB and ImageNet-64
